svg.title: Hand forces on a pole as its center of gravity moves
svg.desc: A 49.0-newton pole is held with hands 0.900 meters apart. As its center of gravity moves from midway, toward the right hand, then outside the left hand, the hand forces change, and the right hand ends up pushing down. Animated motion has a static alternative for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Where the cg sits decides how the hands share the load
Uniform 5.00-kg pole, hands 0.900 m apart. FL + FR = w and torques about either hand balance; with
the cg outside the hands, one hand pushes down.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
